'''Fluffle''' is a [[Lightning]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves into [[Nimbuzzy]] at 6 bronze stars.

==Overview==
Current Description: "Fluffle is painfully shy and floats most of the time, landing only when the air thins. Anyone who tries to say hello might get a jolt, as those nerves tend to spark."

Fluffle is a purple rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
Fluffle is a round sheep that hovers in the air above a small lightning bolt. Its wool is white and resembles a cloud, and it has no limbs. In place of a mouth it has an X-shaped mark, and it has floppy ears. Its skin is a deep blue, and it has orange irises with yellow, slit pupils. When it electrifies itself in its idle animation, its skeleton is shown briefly, and it turns into a darker shade for a short time.

Fluffle's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces blue with purple.

== Evolution Trial ==
Fluffle's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 6 bronze stars/19 copies. To evolve it into [[Nimbuzzy]] you need to complete the following task:
* Feed Fluffle Fluff Candy x3.

==Trivia==
* Fluffle and its evolutions could be a joke about white and black sheep as white and black clouds, along with wool and other fabrics conducting static electricity. 
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Trainer and Chef Felicia created 'Butt-Zap Bites' to taste exactly like biting a Fluffle's rear. Why? We don't know."
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Floats most of the time, landing only when the air thins. Fluffle's thoughts remain a mystery."
